workshoptitle: Project Inception: Enterprise AI Fabric Companion LiveLab

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Understand the Enterprise AI Fabric, the companion LiveLab model, and the workshop outcomes.

tutorials.title: Get Started
tutorials.description: Sign in to the Oracle Cloud Console when your implementation exercise uses an OCI tenancy.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Plan Your Companion Implementation
tutorials.description: Confirm access, prerequisites, scope, and the implementation decisions required for a customer engagement.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Design the Fabric Foundation
tutorials.description: Map the reusable runtime, agent patterns, data, identity, and observability components to your solution.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Select MCP Servers and a Recipe
tutorials.description: Choose the governed tool boundary and use Smart Dispatch as the reference implementation walkthrough.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Apply Governance and Security
tutorials.description: Design identity propagation, tool exposure, data controls, guardrails, logging, and evaluation.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Prepare for Production
tutorials.description: Create a deployment sequence, validation plan, operational model, and customer handoff package.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Choose Your Next Step
tutorials.description: Request the implementation package, select a recipe, and plan a supported customer delivery.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Review common LiveLabs questions and support options.
